digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: bridge projects mapping must be stored at store level (not repo level) in a new projects.json file separate from bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json to avoid diff conflicts when multiple repos sync different project subsets against a shared snapshot

CLI verb group bridge projects must support set, list, and remove subcommands with identical read/write behavior across CLI, library (_lib_ops.py), and MCP surfaces (list as READ_ONLY read tool, set/remove as write tools)

resolve_project function must implement tri-state rule: return legacy_default for absent ticket field, None for explicit empty string, and the project key for set values; returning None when legacy_default itself is empty
absent projects.json record is legal and reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default (fail-safe until seeded by sibling story); malformed record raises an error
set command must require --repos argument and support --repos empty string to explicitly store empty list; subsequent set on existing key replaces repos list rather than merging
pinned help contract: bridge.txt and parser metavar verb set must both name projects verb and remain byte-identical to their previous state after any write operation
